description_en: Modifies the information about a user group
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to modify the information about the user group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改用户组信息的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to modify the information about the user group.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改用户组信息的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the user group. This name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的用户组名称。最多支持128字符
parameters.name: user_group_name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the user group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的用户组备注信息。最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment
